scene_title_en: Harry and Dumbledore in the office
description_en: Post-Sirius conversation in Dumbledore's office; replaces the book's scene where Harry wrecks the office in grief.
Death Eater / Ministry worker Yaxley arrives at the Granger family home.
Hagrid tries to shoot down a bird; the Whomping Willow kills it.
Alternate/extended CGI shot of the rogue Bludger chasing Harry.
Extended version of Snape's first classroom confrontation with Harry.
A Hogwarts letter comes out of an egg Petunia cracks.
Karkaroff shows the Dark Mark on his arm; includes Ron's reaction.
Brief romantic look between Ginny and Harry.
Ron and Harry hunt a rabbit and end up casting spells at each other.
Long scene of Trelawney eating chaotically in the Great Hall.
Seated alternate take of the Aberforth conversation, later reshot standing.
Comic beat between Filch and Umbridge after the twins' departure.
Harry and Dumbledore outside the school; Harry says he isn't worried because he's with Dumbledore.
Harry and Hermione running from Nagini at Godric's Hollow (no finished CGI).

scene_title_en: Harry asks Cho to the ball
description_en: Harry attempts to invite Cho to the Yule Ball.
Lockhart makes the class take a quiz about his favourite colour and Best Smile awards.
Longer version of Harry's first meeting with Colin.
Extended version including the Dursleys' reactions to the levitating cake.
Harry gets Dudley's boiled hand-me-down uniform while Dudley is photographed in new clothes.

scene_title_en: Harry tells Ron about the Chamber
description_en: Harry tells Ron he believes Hagrid opened the Chamber of Secrets.
Right after the diary vision, Harry meets Hagrid carrying a rooster and is frightened.
Harry and Hermione argue about the map and Draco disappearing from Hogwarts.

scene_title_en: Harry and Dumbledore arrive at the Cave
description_en: Includes the knife moment and a mention of Regulus Black.

scene_title_en: Harry and Dumbledore leave the Cave
description_en: A weakened Dumbledore says he isn't worried because he's with Harry.
Ron and Hermione quietly worry about Harry after Sirius's death.
Durmstrang students asking Hogwarts students to the ball.

scene_title_en: Filch and the Slytherins in the dungeons
description_en: Filch escorting the Slytherin students down to the dungeons during the evacuation of Hogwarts.
Ron and Hermione share a quiet moment skipping/throwing stones.
Bill Weasley warns Harry, Ron and Hermione at Shell Cottage.

scene_title_en: Hagrid and Harry on the Underground
description_en: Hagrid and Harry ride the London tube; Hagrid talks about wanting a dragon.
Umbridge watches students bully a younger boy and considers recruiting them.

scene_title_en: Crabbe and Goyle meet Ron and Harry
description_en: The real Crabbe and Goyle come face to face with their Polyjuiced doubles.
Extended Knight Bus ride with the shrunken head.
Seamus and Neville rigging the wooden bridge with explosives.
Harry, Ron and Hermione discuss Crouch's death and what it means.
Umbridge evaluates Trelawney's Divination class.
Moody roughs Harry up; Crouch Sr. sees his son's face in Moody.
Umbridge justifies her actions to the students, humanising her, then threatens Harry.
The knight portrait guarding Gryffindor Tower, changing passwords constantly.

scene_title_en: Hermione and Harry talk about Draco
description_en: Hermione shows empathy for Draco's condition; Harry refuses to.

scene_title_en: The Ford Anglia in the Forbidden Forest
description_en: The car living wild in the forest.
Harry and Ron drag the unconscious bodies of Crabbe and Goyle and brew the potion.
After Sirius breaks in; Gryffindors in pyjamas, Sir Cadogan, McGonagall comforting Neville.

scene_title_en: Harry and Luna at Dobby's grave
description_en: Luna thanks Dobby; Ron tells Harry he believes him about seeing Dumbledore.

scene_title_en: The Weird Sisters at the Yule Ball
description_en: Full concert performance, including students lifting Flitwick.
Justin introduces himself to Harry before the duelling club snake incident.
The twins joke about Harry being the Heir of Slytherin while he fears turning dark.
Start of the flying car journey; a Muggle reacts to magic.
Injured Ron warns them not to say Voldemort's name because it is now Taboo-tracked.
After Seamus calls Harry a liar, Neville speaks up for him.
Students playing wizard games in the Great Hall; Harry is happy for his friends despite missing out.

scene_title_en: Arthur Weasley and his Muggle toys
description_en: Ron finds his father tinkering with Muggle objects (Potterwatch radio prototype).
Harry alone with Hedwig, then Hufflepuff students arguing about whether he is the Heir.
Ron recalls Riddle's award from his detention; includes the Ravenclaw ghost fragment and hospital wing time.
Snape chases couples out of the Yule Ball gardens and argues with Karkaroff.
In the Ministry, Ron stays silent while Harry-as-Runcorn defends Arthur Weasley.
Neville with his plant, Dean and Seamus joking, Harry alone on the sofa.
Common room scene: anti-cheating quills, Seamus, Neville with bound legs.
Filch panics over his Kwikspell/Squib correspondence being discovered.

scene_title_en: Tonks arrives at the Battle of Hogwarts
description_en: Tonks leaves her son behind to fight beside Lupin.
Harry cannot stop returning to the mirror; Ron worries about him.

scene_title_en: Draco and Lucius at Borgin and Burkes
description_en: Lucius mistreats Draco; Draco touches the Vanishing Cabinet.
Petunia's cold but painful farewell to Harry, acknowledging she also lost a sister.
After Dumbledore's death; Harry tells Ron and Hermione they are brilliant and they refuse to leave him alone.

scene_title_en: The birth of the Golden Trio
description_en: Harry, Ron and Hermione leaving the bathroom after the troll; Harry defends Hermione, Ron says that's what friends are for.
Choir sequence intercut with McGonagall, Snape and Draco before the Death Eaters attack.
Dudley tells Harry he doesn't think he is a waste of space and asks why he isn't coming with them.
The whole school singing the Hogwarts school song, plus the Durmstrang/Beauxbatons arrival context.
